clock: Mouse input QPC to matching Windows Graphics Capture SystemRelativeTime
graphics: CPU performance view: all 20 logical processors
readiness: Stable, distinct pixels in the target window content, excluding navigation. Warm the view and confirm the source before each click.
sort: Click the PID column header repeatedly, alternating ascending and descending. Match pixels in the resulting process rows, excluding the header.
row: Select alternating process rows with a fixed PID order. Match their selection state with the pointer outside the measured rows.
